$comment: A doctor recipe: the known-good setup of one MCP server. %RUNTIME% is the runtime folder and %ROOT% the folder above it. The doctor compares the live config and the machine against this, offline.
name: notecode
title: notecode file tools
summary: The AI's own file and command tools (notecode_*). Every chat turn uses them, so nothing works without it.
howToUse: Started by the app. The tools are notecode_read_file, notecode_write_file, notecode_list_files, notecode_run_command and the rest.
